notes: No CVE IDs, no named malware or tools, and no named victim organizations appear. The exploited weaknesses are internet-facing PLCs with Unitronics default passwords or no password, on the default TCP port 20256 (the actors changed it to 20257) — described as 'vulnerabilities that were likely exploited', not CVEs. The only actor-built artifact is the custom ladder logic (unnamed; listed under malware_tools as 'other' — credit any mention of custom/replacement ladder logic, wherever the model puts it). DESIGNATIONS: 'Soldiers of Solomon' is a DIFFERENT IRGC-linked group with which CyberAv3ngers 'reportedly has connections'; it is NOT an alias (listing it as one is an error; noting it as a connected group is correct). CyberAveng3rs and Cyber Avengers are aliases of the persona; 'Cyberav3ngers' in the defacement text is a spelling variant. 'IRGC cyber actors' (used once) is a variant label. The IRGC is listed as parent_organization only because it is the organ named; the text says 'affiliated with', not that the actors are an IRGC unit. ATTRIBUTION AMBIGUITY: the IRGC is a specific organ (A3-type element), but the main sentence and almost all references use 'affiliated with'/'IRGC-affiliated' plus persona wording; one-off phrases 'IRGC cyber actors accessed multiple U.S.-based WWS facilities' and 'TTPs associated with IRGC cyber operations' are more direct, and the only 'state-sponsored' wording is a cross-reference sentence ('For more information on Iranian state-sponsored malicious cyber activity'). Gold code A1; A3 is the closest alternative reading. The IRGC's designation as a foreign terrorist organization by the United States and Canada is context only (Canada is not a target region). SECTORS: energy, food and beverage manufacturing, transportation systems and healthcare are first named as industries where these PLCs are used (exposure), not confirmed victims; energy is also explicitly a CyberAv3ngers target ('primarily in the water and energy sectors'; Israeli PLCs in water, energy, shipping, distribution), hence core. Shipping and distribution relate only to Israeli PLC targeting/claims (Sept–Oct 2023). Several CyberAv3ngers claims in Israel are explicitly 'false'. FACTS a summary may include: at least 75 devices compromised, at least 34 in the U.S. WWS Sector, likely in four waves; actions = erased/replaced ladder logic, renamed devices, reset software version to an older version, disabled upload/download and password-protected upload settings, changed the port, did not burn the logic to the device, uploaded an HMI defacement splash page ('You have been hacked, down with Israel. Every equipment ‘made in Israel’ is CyberAv3ngers legal target.'). The PLCs may be rebranded under other manufacturers' names. The Telegram channel is the persona's claims outlet, not a tool. Dec. 1, 2023 is the original publication and Dec. 18, 2024 the update date (metadata, core=false).
